column1: DEFINITION NOTE - read before adopting any lipid number.

The L in K_PW = W + L*a*Kow^b is an OPERATIONALLY DEFINED octanol-like phase calibrated so the expression reproduces measured RCF - it is not a proximate crude-fat number. Briggs' own barley anchor L*a = 10^-1.52 implies L ~ 2.5 % of FRESH weight. Measured rice straw spans 0.14-1.0 % dry weight as crude fat (ether extract, feed tables) but 3.4 % dry weight as dichloromethane lipophilic extractives (A2) - a 3-24x spread that is a difference of DEFINITION, not of measurement quality. Substituting a proximate value therefore changes what the parameter MEANS, not just its value, and can be worse than the current cited-soybean state. This is the same class of trap as the three basis errors this repo has already hit (Tang fresh/dry, the lipid basis correction, Hwang's unstated basis).
